description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for handling recipe browsing, viewing, and importing within the Coocook application. It includes methods for listing recipes, viewing a specific recipe, and importing recipes from other projects, with associated URL generation and access control.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Browse::Recipe
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for browsing and viewing recipes, handling URL routing and actions related to recipes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles listing recipes, including filtering for public recipes and user-specific recipes, and prepares data for rendering.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures recipe ID and URL name, fetches the recipe from the database, and sets up the stash for further actions.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Prepares the interface for importing recipes from other projects, generating URLs for import actions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a specific recipe, including ingredients and related project information, with access control.
